messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — publish pipeline is blocked. typegen regen diff from the sample-app onboarding changed auth/retry property names and tripped the semver/changelog gate.

ryan: Which CI job failed? link: https://ci.internal/pipelines/4821 (typegen-regendiff)

alex: Job is `typegen-regendiff` on linux. Failure excerpt:
```diff
-  retryOptions?: RetryOpts;
+  retry_options?: RetryOpts;
```
I can reproduce locally when running openapi-regen v3.2.0; CI currently pins v3.1.2.

kim: Sounds like the regen tool added a normalization pass that converts some fields to snake_case. That leak into the SDK surface is bad UX.

ci-bot: release-check:semver FAILED — unexpected artifact diff detected (typegen-regendiff). To proceed, update changelog/semver or revert generator change.

ryan: Short-term unblock: pin openapi-regen to 3.1.* in CI and rerun the matrix to allow the publish to proceed. Also open an ops ticket to coordinate a deliberate regen.

kim: Long-term fixes: 1) add an explicit property-name mapping step in the codegen pipeline so OpenAPI renames don't change public SDK shape (preserve camelCase), 2) add a lightweight smoke test in the sample-app onboarding that asserts the public auth/retry option names, 3) add a release-checklist item for verifying typegen/toolchain version parity.

alex: I'll push the CI pin now and run a full regen on a branch to produce a diff summary. If diffs are purely naming we can ship a minor with a changelog note; if behavior changed we need to revert the regen.

release-bot: rerun triggered by alex — queued job 4821.

alex: Posting the regen-summary once it's up. Ping @kim @ryan if you can triage the generated auth tests when available.
